# Local interface dependencies

- `gsap.min.js`: GSAP 3.14.2, downloaded from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.14.2/dist/gsap.min.js. Copyright and licence notice are retained in the file; terms: https://gsap.com/standard-license/.
- `onest-*.woff2`, `fonts.css`: Onest variable font, Google Fonts version v11, weights 400–700, including Cyrillic subsets. Original CSS: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Onest:wght@400..700&display=swap. Licence: `Onest-OFL.txt` (SIL Open Font License 1.1).

All files are served by the application. Opening the site makes no font or animation requests to a third-party CDN.
